# Smart Resource Multiplier 1.3.2 for Minecraft 26.1–26.1.2

This release brings Smart Resource Multiplier to Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.1, and 26.1.2 on Fabric and NeoForge.

> Minecraft 26.2 remains the newest release and the default version shown on the repository. Use only the file matching your Minecraft version and mod loader.

## Highlights

- The same block-drop, entity-loot, Block XP, Mob XP, shearing, placement-protection, preset, and in-game configuration features as the Minecraft 26.2 release.
- A single Fabric JAR supports Minecraft 26.1 through 26.1.2.
- NeoForge builds are provided separately for Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.1, and 26.1.2.
- Polished configuration screens with centered multiplier values, clean tooltips, and consistent controls.
- Tested in-game on all six listed Minecraft-version and loader combinations.

## Downloads

Choose exactly one file:

- **Fabric 26.1–26.1.2:** `smart-resource-multiplier-fabric-1.3.2+mc26.1-26.1.2.jar`
- **NeoForge 26.1:** `smart-resource-multiplier-neoforge-1.3.2+mc26.1.jar`
- **NeoForge 26.1.1:** `smart-resource-multiplier-neoforge-1.3.2+mc26.1.1.jar`
- **NeoForge 26.1.2:** `smart-resource-multiplier-neoforge-1.3.2+mc26.1.2.jar`

Fabric also requires Fabric API. Never install Fabric and NeoForge files together. Back up important worlds before changing Minecraft versions or mod loaders.

# Smart Resource Multiplier 1.3.2 for Minecraft 1.19.2

This release brings Smart Resource Multiplier to Minecraft 1.19.2 on Fabric and Forge.

> Minecraft 26.2 remains the newest release and the default version shown on the repository. Use these files only with Minecraft 1.19.2.

## Highlights

- Configurable block drops, entity loot, Block XP, Mob XP, supported shearing, Smart Placement Protection, categories, filters, overrides, dimensions, and presets.
- Improved search boxes, cleaner menu spacing, centered multiplier values, and text that stays inside its panels.
- Fixed search hints remaining visible while typing.
- Fixed overlapping Forge configuration controls and a crash that could occur while viewing the mod icon in Forge's Mods screen.
- Tested in-game on both Fabric and Forge.

## Downloads

- **Fabric:** `smart-resource-multiplier-fabric-1.3.2+mc1.19.2.jar`
- **Forge:** `smart-resource-multiplier-forge-1.3.2+mc1.19.2.jar`

Install only the file for your loader. Fabric also requires Fabric API. Back up worlds before changing Minecraft versions or mod loaders.

# Smart Resource Multiplier 1.3.2 for Minecraft 1.12.2

Smart Resource Multiplier is now available for Minecraft 1.12.2 on Forge.

> Minecraft 26.2 remains the newest release and the default version shown on the repository. Use this file only with Minecraft 1.12.2 and Forge.

## Highlights

- Configurable block drops, entity loot, Block XP, Mob XP, supported manual shearing, Smart Placement Protection, categories, filters, overrides, dimensions, and presets.
- A compact configuration menu designed for older Minecraft versions.
- The Forge Mods-list **Config** button opens editable settings, and saved changes remain after reopening the menu.
- Open settings with `/smartdropsgui` or `/srm`.
- Tested in-game on Minecraft 1.12.2.

## Download

- **Forge:** `smart-resource-multiplier-forge-1.3.2+mc1.12.2.jar`

Forge and Java 8 are required. Automated dispenser shearing is not available in vanilla Minecraft 1.12.2. Back up important worlds before changing Minecraft versions.

# Smart Resource Multiplier 1.3.0 for Minecraft 1.21.11

This release brings the complete Smart Resource Multiplier 1.3.0 experience to Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11 on both Fabric and NeoForge.

> Minecraft 26.2 remains the newest release and the default version shown on the repository. Use this backport only for a Minecraft 1.21.11 instance.

## What is included

- The same block, entity-drop, mob-XP, and supported shearing multipliers as the 26.2 version.
- The same in-game configuration screens, including the clearer **Multiply Block XP** label.
- The same placement protection, output safety limits, commands, presets, filters, and multiplayer permissions.
- Separate, native builds for Fabric and NeoForge.
- Compatibility adjustments for Minecraft 1.21.11 and Java 21.

## Downloads

Choose exactly one file for your loader:

- **Fabric:** `smart-resource-multiplier-1.3.0+mc1.21.11.jar`
- **NeoForge:** `smart-resource-multiplier-neoforge-1.3.0+mc1.21.11.jar`

Do not install both files in the same Minecraft instance. Fabric also requires Fabric API. Back up important worlds before changing mod loaders.

## Tested

Both builds are compiled and tested specifically against Minecraft 1.21.11. Automated checks cover resource multiplication, placement protection, entity loot and XP, shearing, commands, configuration screens, multiplayer authority, loader metadata, and release-JAR contents.

The mod keeps its existing `smart_resource_drops` identity and schema 3 configuration, so its settings, commands, datapack namespace, and multiplayer behavior stay consistent with the 1.3.0 feature release.
